# Floor & Decor Grows Florida Footprint With New Palmetto Bay Location


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_813f56d3ece87a0aadfb78cb74e6b5ee/flooranddecor/news/2026-11-05_Floor_Decor_Grows_Florida_Footprint_With_New_311.pdf) November 05, 2026 8:35am EST


*—* *Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring marks its third new Florida store this quarter, bringing its expansive in-stock selection and warehouse-format shopping experience to South Miami-Dade —*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its newest Florida warehouse store and design center in Palmetto Bay at 16051 S. Dixie Highway. The Palmetto Bay location is the company’s third new Florida location this quarter, and its 9th warehouse store in the Miami–Fort Lauderdale area. Floor & Decor now operates 39 warehouse stores across Florida.


The Palmetto Bay store opens with a team of approximately 40 associates led by Scarlet Garcia, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.


The new store gives South Miami-Dade homeowners and professionals another convenient neighborhood option for a broad assortment of in-stock tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, including waterproof styles suited to Florida living, along with installation materials, decorative accessories and related categories at everyday low prices.


“We’re excited to open our doors in Palmetto Bay and serve even more Pros and homeowners across South Florida,” said Garcia. “This new store reflects our continued commitment to bringing great products, expert guidance and strong value closer to the customers who rely on us. We look forward to connecting with the community and being a trusted resource for their home projects.”


The new Palmetto Bay store opens to customers today, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony and official grand opening on Thursday, November 12, followed by a community Block Party on Saturday, November 14.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony** Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Thursday, November 12, at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the South Dade Chamber of Commerce.


**Block Party Celebration** On Saturday, November 14, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. ET, the store will host a Block Party for the Palmetto Bay community, featuring prize drawings every 15 minutes, with prizes including tickets to professional sporting events, a deep-sea fishing charter for four, a four-day Bahamas cruise, a Yeti cooler, an iPad and more*.


Local businesses Ives & Bees, Cloud 9 Bakery and Sophia’s Cup will be on site with free items for the first 200 customers, and guests can enjoy a complimentary lunch from Cuban Guy Food Truck, The Brothers Kitchen Food Truck or Street Twist Grill. For more information, visit[www.flooranddecor.com/palmettobaypro](http://www.flooranddecor.com/palmettobaypro) .


**Store Facts & Features**


- Location: 16051 S. Dixie Highway, Miami, FL 33157
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
- Phone Number: (786) 885-6533

**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.** Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of September 24, 2026, the Company operated 282 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
